title: Inventory software message
passage:
To: Branch supervisors
From: Lila Chen, Systems Support
Subject: StockView mobile update

Version 4.2 of StockView will be available Monday. It allows employees to count stock without a network connection and upload the results later. This should be particularly helpful in our basement storage areas, where the wireless signal is unreliable.

Please install the update on one tablet per branch initially. Use that tablet for Monday's closing count, then compare its totals with your paper record. Send any discrepancies to me by 10 a.m. Tuesday, including the item code and tablet model. Do not update the remaining tablets until I send a confirmation email. The desktop version is unaffected, and no changes to employee passwords are required. A five-minute demonstration is attached; it explains how to identify counts that have not yet been uploaded.
passageZh:
收件者：各分店主管
寄件者：系統支援 Lila Chen
主旨：StockView 行動版更新

StockView 4.2 版將於星期一推出，可讓員工在沒有網路時盤點，稍後再上傳結果。地下室儲藏區的無線訊號不穩，這項功能尤其有幫助。

一開始請每家分店只更新一台平板。使用該平板進行星期一閉店盤點，再與紙本紀錄核對。若有差異，請最遲於星期二上午十點寄信告知我，附上品項代碼及平板型號。收到我的確認信前，不要更新其他平板。桌面版不受影響，員工也不必更改密碼。附件為五分鐘示範，說明如何辨識尚未上傳的盤點資料。
